I wrote `component.html` in the folder. I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout and styling are unchecked.

It follows `DESIGN.md`. All the content is exactly as you gave it, inside a single `#component` element 1280px wide. It is static HTML and CSS only.

- **Fonts:** The folder has no font files, so Unbounded and Archivo are named but will fall back to Helvetica or Arial unless they are installed locally.
- **Switch defaults:** You didn't say which switches start on. I set "Email me when a request is assigned to me" and "Weekly summary" on, and "Product updates" off.
- **Delete button:** `DESIGN.md` has no red, so "Delete Workspace" is a quiet button with an ink outline. The Danger zone card has an ink border to set it apart.
- **Save and Delete buttons:** Both are plain buttons that do nothing, since there's no JavaScript.

`session.json` was empty, and `session.err` only logged an unrecognized-model warning. Neither affected the work.
